title: A lock traded for a dataclass
why: The class was rewritten as a dataclass and the lock went with the rewrite, while the lock is what made the counter safe for the threads the docstring still mentions. Nothing in the new lines is wrong on its own, so the defect is only visible against what the previous revision guaranteed.

planted.problem: The update no longer holds the lock, so two threads can read and write the total at once and one increment is lost
